sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shows" ("tmdb_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "imdb_id" TEXT NULL, "title" TEXT NULL, "year" INTEGER NULL, "overview" TEXT NULL, "tagline" TEXT NULL, "first_air_date" TEXT NULL, "last_air_date" TEXT NULL, "runtime" INTEGER NULL, "certification" TEXT NULL, "network" TEXT NULL, "country" TEXT NULL, "language" TEXT NULL, "trailer" TEXT NULL, "homepage" TEXT NULL, "vote_average" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "vote_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "popularity" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "number_of_seasons" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "next_episode_air_date" TEXT NULL, "next_episode_season" INTEGER NULL, "next_episode_number" INTEGER NULL, "genres" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "status" TEXT NULL, "poster_path" TEXT NULL, "backdrop_path" TEXT NULL, "fetched_at" INTEGER NULL, "tracked_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "watch_providers_region" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("tmdb_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "seasons" ("show_tmdb_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "season" INTEGER NOT NULL, "tmdb_id" INTEGER NULL, "title" TEXT NULL, "episode_count" INTEGER NULL, "air_date" TEXT NULL, "poster_path" TEXT NULL, "fetched_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("show_tmdb_id", "season"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "episodes" ("show_tmdb_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "season" INTEGER NOT NULL, "episode" INTEGER NOT NULL, "tmdb_id" INTEGER NULL, "imdb_id" TEXT NULL, "title" TEXT NULL, "overview" TEXT NULL, "vote_average" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "vote_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "runtime" INTEGER NULL, "air_date" TEXT NULL, "episode_type" TEXT NULL, "still_path" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("show_tmdb_id", "season", "episode"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "movies" ("tmdb_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "imdb_id" TEXT NULL, "title" TEXT NULL, "year" INTEGER NULL, "overview" TEXT NULL, "tagline" TEXT NULL, "release_date" TEXT NULL, "runtime" INTEGER NULL, "certification" TEXT NULL, "country" TEXT NULL, "language" TEXT NULL, "trailer" TEXT NULL, "homepage" TEXT NULL, "vote_average" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "vote_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "popularity" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "genres" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "status" TEXT NULL, "poster_path" TEXT NULL, "backdrop_path" TEXT NULL, "fetched_at" INTEGER NULL, "tracked_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "watch_providers_region" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("tmdb_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "snapshot_documents" ("type" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (type IN ('movie', 'show', 'season')), "tmdb_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "season" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "metadata_json" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("type", "tmdb_id", "season"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "genres" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "synchronized_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id", "type"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "caches" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "customData" TEXT NOT NULL, "synchronized_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "history_items" ("history_id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "tmdb_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "season" INTEGER NOT NULL, "episode" INTEGER NOT NULL, "action" TEXT NOT NULL, "watched_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "user_ratings" ("type" TEXT NOT NULL, "tmdb_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "season" INTEGER NOT NULL, "episode" INTEGER NOT NULL, "rating" INTEGER NOT NULL, "rated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("type", "tmdb_id", "season", "episode"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "watchlists" ("type" TEXT NOT NULL, "tmdb_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "season" INTEGER NOT NULL, "episode" INTEGER NOT NULL, "listed_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("type", "tmdb_id", "season", "episode"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "show_states" ("show_tmdb_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('watching', 'watched', 'dropped')), "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("show_tmdb_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "favorite_items" ("type" TEXT NOT NULL, "tmdb_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "favorited_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("type", "tmdb_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "job_states" ("job_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL, "error_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "userMessage" TEXT NULL, "started_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "finished_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("job_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tmdb_sync_outbox" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "operation" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "tmdb_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "season" INTEGER NOT NULL, "episode" INTEGER NOT NULL, "rating" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_error" TEXT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pending_deletions" ("type" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (type IN ('movie', 'show')), "tmdb_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "queued_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("type", "tmdb_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "asset_jobs" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "provider" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'tmdb', "media_type" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (media_type IN ('movie', 'show')), "item_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('poster', 'backdrop', 'seasonPoster', 'still', 'cast')), "size" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_url" TEXT NOT NULL, "dest_path" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'done', 'failed')), "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "next_retry_at" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "last_error" TEXT NULL);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_episodes_air_date ON episodes (air_date)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_history_items_key ON history_items (type, tmdb_id, season, episode)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_history_items_watched_at ON history_items (watched_at)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_asset_jobs_status ON asset_jobs (status, next_retry_at)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_asset_jobs_item ON asset_jobs (media_type, item_id)
